lines.say: Setting up Zoho CRM? The order matters more than the features.
lines.show: Setting up Zoho CRM? The order matters more than the features.

lines.say: Start with company settings. Time zone, currency, fiscal year and hierarchy.
lines.show: Start with company settings. Time zone, currency, fiscal year and hierarchy.

lines.say: Then access. Roles, profiles and sharing, before you invite anyone.
lines.show: Then access. Roles, profiles and sharing, before you invite anyone.

lines.say: Records are private by default. Sharing rules can only widen access.
lines.show: Records are private by default. Sharing rules can only widen access.

lines.say: Shape the pipeline to how you really sell. Then connect email.
lines.show: Shape the pipeline to how you really sell. Then connect email.

lines.say: Rules before data. Zoho says set up automation before you import.
lines.show: Rules before data. Zoho says set up automation before you import.

lines.say: Import fifty rows first. Once an import starts, it can't be cancelled.
lines.show: Import 50 rows first. Once an import starts, it can't be cancelled.

lines.say: Launch with a pilot group. Then review after two to four weeks.
lines.show: Launch with a pilot group. Then review after two to four weeks.

lines.say: Read the full step by step guide at Zoo doe works dot com.
lines.show: Read the full step-by-step guide at zudoworks.com
